request.spec:
Backing is now the sum of the patrons' settled figures over their SETTLED claims dated within the
90 days up to and including the sheet's today (each at its frozen figure), 0.00 with none.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Backing is now the sum of the patrons' settled figures over their SETTLED claims dated within the
90 days up to and including the sheet's today (each at its frozen figure), 0.00 with none.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
A person's backing now adds up their patrons' SETTLED claims dated in the 90 days up to and including the sheet's today, each at the figure frozen when it was settled. It shows 0.00 when there are none. All 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass. After that run I only edited a header comment, so I didn't rerun the tests.

**What changed:** only `backingOf` in `src/main/frontend/src/app/features/people/people.ts`, plus that file's header comment. Backing was already worked out only in the front end, and the server and stored data already hold each settled claim's frozen figure (`settledDue`), so no server or schema change was needed.

**How the window and figures are handled:**
- The window runs from today minus 89 days through today, inclusive. In the test, with today at 2026-03-10, the claim dated 2025-12-11 counts and the one dated 2025-12-01 doesn't.
- Claims dated after the sheet's today are left out.
- If a claim was settled while its grade had no rate, it has no frozen figure, and I skip it rather than count it as its live due. The request doesn't cover this case, so say if you want it treated differently.

**Out-of-date comment:** the comment in `V22__person_patron.sql` still describes the old rule (the patrons' due-totals added up). I left it because changing a migration that has already been applied can break the database's migration check.
